metric: upper_bound_ratio = 1 - |union_q S_q| / sum_q |S_q| over ALL non-dense columns q of a chunk, |S_q| = top: the w->inf asymptote no CTA can stage. tile_union[width] = 1 - |union_{q in tile} S_q| / (|tile| * top) over consecutive-column tiles, reported as per-layer mean/min/max over the layers.
